subject: ONE barrel sponge creature, porous yellow body, stubby arms, two big round eyes, swelling fatter in EVERY beat, never planted
second_characters: ONE crab hurling goods off his counter, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp whipping across the lens; from 6.10 TWO huge hands wringing him

motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat. The camera orbits him at speed, never parking, counters swinging behind. The world flies at him: goods, crates and the second characters tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, a new shot size each beat, medium to very close. He swells wider in EVERY beat. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable

timeline.a: already diving off tilting crates, he swings the vacuum into a counter heaped with fruit and boots, the heap tearing past the lens into his pores
he whips the hose overhead and swallows ONE television whole, puffing half again as wide, the shrimp whipping across the lens
he hauls the hose the full frame width, dragging in sausages, tyres and ONE fat armchair, ballooning to twice his width, the crab flinging more at his eyes
bloated to three times his width, he shoves his round fat face at the lens, eyes crossed, a spanner poking out of him
huge and round, he tumbles head over heel the full frame width over the counters he cleaned out, ONE bubble leaving him
TWO huge hands haul him up and wring him double, dirty water bursting out and his body shrinking small
they wring harder and screws, bolts, springs and cogs hail out of him past the lens, the crab reeling back
they fling his wrung flat body across the frame, the television dropping out of him in pieces
flat and wrinkled, he drives his goofy face at the lens, tongue out and eyes rolling apart
he swallows a fresh crate and swells round again in their hands
the hands wring him once more and ONE bent spring shoots past the lens
